from collections import Counter
def fix(g, noise=None):
    n=len(g); res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            v=[g[i][j],g[i][n-1-j],g[n-1-i][j],g[n-1-i][n-1-j]]
            c=Counter(v)
            if noise is not None and noise in c and len(c)>1:
                del c[noise]
            res[i][j]=max(c,key=lambda x:(c[x],-x))
